newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus central bank bond average yield 6.94 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus central bank bond average yield 6.94 pct.

text.p: Cyprus's central bank on Tuesday sold five-year government development bonds worth 21 million pounds ($42 million) with an average yield of 6.94 percent, the bank said in a statement.
The bonds will be the first to trade on the Cyprus stock exchange and central bank officials expect them to be floated on the bourse in April upon instructions of the finance minister.
The average price of competitive bids accepted was 100.25 pounds with a yield of 6.94 percent. Non competitive bids were accepted at this price.

The lowest price of the competitive bids accepted by the bank was 99.21 pounds, with a yield of 7.190 percent. The highest price of competitive bids accepted was 101.20 pounds with a yield of 6.715 percent, the bank said.
The bonds were priced at par.
The central bank said bids totalling 25.6 million pounds were made for the 21 million pound worth of bonds on offer.
It said it accepted competitive bids worth 16.68 million pounds and non competitive bids worth 4.32 million.
The bonds have a coupon of seven percent payable half-yearly. ($=0.501 pounds)
